title: New York in Eight Growth Rings
summary: From the Battery's 1626 palisade, trace New York's outward expansion along rivers and avenues through eight transformative eras, returning to the harbor where every era's ring glows in unison.

fields.director_notes: Directed with MiniMax M3.1 Flash (model minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash via SandBase API). Brief: Trace New York's outward growth along rivers and roads across 8 historical eras (1626 to Present), returning to The Battery. Produced using city-through-time, MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD narration, real OSM geometry, and OpenFreeMap vector basemap.
fields.my_city_line: From palisade to skyline, New York grows in rings.
